bullets.text: A cyclonic storm is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal by November 1, bringing moderate rain to Chennai.
Damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Thiruvallur put public safety at risk, prompting calls for urgent repairs by the State Highways department.

stories.title: Cyclone likely in Bay, moderate rain in Chennai today
takeaways: A cyclonic storm over the Bay of Bengal is expected by November 1 heading towards Andhra Pradesh.
Moderate rainfall is predicted for Chennai today requiring proactive monitoring of local drainage.

stories.title: Chennai Citizen Connect: Damaged pathway on Manavalanagar ROB puts public at risk
takeaways: Broken concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Tiruvallur district endanger local pedestrians.
Residents demand immediate intervention from the State Highways department to ensure public safety.
